title: The Stars with Rhonda: The House Knows What You Did
description: Rhonda reads the family-and-home horoscopes as serene cosmic fact. Group chats, casseroles, and mortgages curdle into domestic doom, and the house itself keeps score.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: The stars, with Rhonda. Easy week ahead, Rhonda?

lines.speaker: rhonda
lines.text: The house already knows, Ronnie. Aries, you host the family dinner. No one rises to help. The house has noticed who cooks. Forever.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Okay, but a dinner is nice, that is, that is bonding.

lines.speaker: rhonda
lines.text: Taurus. The group chat goes silent the moment you type. They are not gone. They started a second chat. The house already knew.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: A second chat? Without me, I mean, without them?

lines.speaker: rhonda
lines.text: Cancer. Your casserole returns. The dish is clean. Too clean. The house has decided you are not coming back.

lines.speaker: rhonda
lines.text: Capricorn. The mortgage outlives you. The house does not grieve. <p:0.3> It simply waits in the hall.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: In the hall. Right. And what is, what is MY sign saying tonight?

lines.speaker: rhonda
lines.text: You are the family dinner, Ronnie. You are what the house has been waiting to cook.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: [question-en] I am the... no. That is not how ovens... <p:0.3> Rhonda, why is the studio so warm?

lines.speaker: rhonda
lines.text: It is preheating, dear. The house is ready for you.
